unit: One bounded public development discussion and a specific review-request-to-artifact link
record_order_warning: The PR was already open before issue50972. Do not narrate the issue as the origin of the PR or use body text edited later as a contemporaneous creation record.

observations.evidence: Issue proposes optional mixed-format parsing while acknowledging ambiguity risk; the referenced community call itself was not obtained.
A reviewer asks about making mixed parsing the default; the reply argues for opt-in using an ambiguous-date example.
observations.class: Visible alternative and reason; not agreement by all or verified global/cultural generalization

observations.evidence: Reviewer asks to recommend an explicit format first in the error message; author acknowledges the point.
observations.class: Specific request and visible uptake; acknowledgment alone is not implementation

observations.evidence: At the pinned merge commit the error message lists a specific format before ISO8601 and mixed alternatives.
observations.class: Artifact-state confirmation consistent with the request; exclusive causal attribution and full implementation review not established

observations.evidence: After positive review, conversation still requests integration/conflict work; a reply reports conflict resolution and a later comment requests another sync.
observations.class: Reported integration constraint. Not proof that every approval was final or that this explains all elapsed time

observations.evidence: Comment states a release-candidate scheduling reason for merging; API independently records merged=true and the merge time/commit.
observations.class: Stated priority plus recorded merge; does not prove the release-candidate schedule improved

observations.evidence: Public2.0.0release metadata and official historical enhancement entry document the mixed-format option linked to issue50972.
observations.class: Release-level evidence for the option, not an independent user outcome

linkage.qualification: Release entry documents the broader option, not the detailed error-message order or its measured benefits.

interpretations_for_review: A concrete request can be checked against reply and artifact instead of inferring completion from a closed label.
The visible discussion includes choices about acceptable default behavior and risk, not only recovery of a fixed fact.
Positive review, integration readiness and release priority are distinct recorded considerations; their independent causal effects are not identified.

comparison_to_current_pilot.fixed_rule_check: The evidence-access design can ask whether a reviewer correctly applies a supplied rule.
comparison_to_current_pilot.choosing_the_rule: This public record also contains disagreement about what the default rule should be. That is outside a correctness score tied to one pre-specified fictional policy.
comparison_to_current_pilot.downstream_rework: Recipient use, burden and rework remain unobserved here. Existing synthetic analysis does not fill that gap.

benchmark_policy: Participant timing illustration not independently reproduced and not used to claim coordination or performance effects.
